newsitem.title: FINLAND: Helsinki ends flat, Nokia gains pre-Motorola Q2.
newsitem.headline: Helsinki ends flat, Nokia gains pre-Motorola Q2.

text.p: Shares ended flat on Tuesday, slowing after five straight record-breaking sessions, though Nokia extended gains ahead of U.S. rival Motorola's second quarter report due after the Wall Street close.
The FOX index closed off 0.19 percent at 1,148.29 points, while the HEX rose 0.09 percent to 3,347.51, scraping to yet another all-time high. Volume was fair at 462 million markka.
With the Dow industrials starting higher and Nokia opening up on Wall Street, brokers said the uptrend looked set to continue after a short breather in Tuesday's session.
Nokia climbed 5.50 markka to 413.00, another record close.
"This market looks resilient to a downturn," one broker said, predicting further gains this week.
Brokers said investors would be watching Motorola's Q2 results for clues to the performance of the mobile phone market, where Helsinki's bourse-engine Nokia is second in the world.
But one said the market has begun to differentiate more between competing telecom equipment makers, and that Nokia would not react sharply unless Motorola came with a major surprise.
Merita trimmed Monday's gains, ending down 0.40 markka at 19.60 after brisk 36 million markka trade, falling away after recent tests of resistance at 20.00 markka.
